column5: The implementation of GHG reduction targets can aid the achievement of renewable energy targets by reducing energy consumption and increasing energy efficiency, thus creating a more favorable environment for the integration of renewable energy sources into the energy mix.

The reduction of GHG emissions can reinforce energy efficiency measures by promoting the use of low-carbon technologies and reducing energy waste, which in turn supports the transition to a low-carbon economy.
